Hataraku Chocobo.name: Hataraku Chocobo
Hataraku Chocobo.summary:
A sim featuring Square's mascot released on the WonderSwan Color in Japan only.
The player must raise a Chocobo while completing various tasks to earn items.

Naruto - Konoha Ninpouchou.name: Naruto: Konoha Ninpouchou
Naruto - Konoha Ninpouchou.summary: Naruto: Konoha Ninpouchou is a RPG based in Naruto anime series. The game follows the Prologue - Land of Waves arc and during the mission battles the player selects Seals in a Scroll to use as commands.
